streamlabs.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Streamlabs right now.

streamlabs.sendTestEvent.description: Fakes a Streamlabs event inside Cuebot, so you can test your triggers. Nothing is sent to Streamlabs and it works without a connection.
streamlabs.sendTestEvent.returns: true when the test event was sent, false when the kind is unknown.
